why: phase-509 P9b item 2 / RFC-0108 "As built in P9b" -- the band of dispatch levels the executor's own worker runs (every level by default). With band workers over the same executor (`Executor::spin_band_once`) the bands partition the levels, so each callback has exactly one worker. rclcpp's multi-threaded executor shares one wait set among its threads and has no notion of a level band; rclrs has one executor thread.
